en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town with fields and gardens in the foreground and dense buildings, church towers, chimneys, and some larger institutional buildings in the background. At the top left in red Gothic-style type is the caption "Waldenburg i. Sa." indicating the town and region. The overall style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.
